units.zh: 室昉耶律賢適女裏郭襲耶律阿沒裏
units.en: Shi Fang, Yelu Xianshi, Nuli, Guo Xi, and Yelu Ameli.
units.literal: Shi Fang, Yelu Xianshi, Nuli, Guo Xi, Yelu Ameli.

units.zh: 室昉，字夢奇，南京人。
units.en: Shi Fang, whose courtesy name was Mengqi, came from Nanjing.
units.literal: Shi Fang, courtesy name Mengqi, was a man of Nanjing.

units.zh: 幼謹厚篤學，不出外戶者二十年，雖里人莫識。
units.en: As a boy he was careful, steadfast, and devoted to study; for twenty years he never stepped outside his gate, and even his neighbors scarcely knew him.
units.literal: In youth he was prudent, earnest, and devoted to learning; for twenty years he did not go beyond the outer gate, so that even his neighbors did not know him.

units.zh: 其精如此。
units.en: Such was the depth of his dedication.
units.literal: Such was his concentration.

units.zh: 會同初，登進士第，為盧龍巡捕官。
units.en: In the early Huitong reign he earned the jinshi degree and was appointed a patrol officer in Lulong.
units.literal: At the beginning of Huitong he passed the jinshi examination and became a patrol officer in Lulong.

units.zh: 太宗入汴受冊禮，詔昉知制誥，總禮儀事。
units.en: When Emperor Taizong entered Bian to receive the investiture rites, Fang was appointed Director of Imperial Edicts with overall charge of ceremonial matters.
units.literal: When Emperor Taizong entered Bian and received the investiture rites, Fang was ordered to serve as Director of Imperial Edicts and to oversee all ritual affairs.

units.zh: 天祿中，為南京留守判官。
units.en: During the Tianlu reign he served as registrar to the Nanjing retention commissioner.
units.literal: During Tianlu he was registrar to the Nanjing retention commissioner.

units.zh: 應歷間，累遷翰林學士，出入禁闥十餘年。
units.en: In the Yingli period he rose through repeated promotions to Hanlin Academician and for more than ten years passed in and out of the inner palace.
units.literal: During Yingli he was repeatedly promoted to Hanlin Academician and for more than ten years went in and out of the forbidden gates.

units.zh: 保寧間，兼政事舍人，數延問古今治亂得失，奏對稱旨。
units.en: Under Baoning he also held the post of Secretariat drafter; the emperor often called him in to discuss what had succeeded or failed in governance through the ages, and his answers always pleased the throne.
units.literal: During Baoning he also served as Secretariat Drafter; the emperor often summoned him to inquire about the gains and losses of order and disorder in past and present, and his replies accorded with the imperial will.

units.zh: 上多昉有理劇才，改南京副留守，決訟平允，人皆便之。
units.en: The emperor admired Fang's gift for settling knotty legal disputes; he was made deputy Nanjing retention commissioner, where his judgments were fair and even-handed, to everyone's satisfaction.
units.literal: The emperor praised Fang for his talent in deciding difficult cases; he was transferred to be deputy Nanjing retention commissioner, judged lawsuits fairly and impartially, and everyone found him convenient.

units.zh: 遷工部尚書，尋改樞密副使，參知政事。
units.en: He was promoted to Minister of Works, then shortly afterward made deputy commissioner of military affairs and participant in governance.
units.literal: He was promoted to Minister of Works, then soon made Deputy Commissioner of Military Affairs and Participant in Governance.

units.zh: 頃之，拜樞密使，兼北府宰相，加同政事門下平章事。
units.en: Before long he was appointed commissioner of military affairs and concurrent northern chancellery chancellor, with the added title of associate chief administrator under the Gate.
units.literal: Shortly thereafter he was appointed Commissioner of Military Affairs, concurrently Northern Chancellery Chancellor, with the added title of Associate Chief Administrator under the Gate.

units.zh: 乾亨初，監修國史。
units.en: At the opening of the Qianheng reign he supervised compilation of the national history.
units.literal: At the beginning of Qianheng he supervised compilation of the national history.

units.zh: 統和元年，告老，不許。
units.en: In the first year of Tonghe he asked to retire on account of age, but the request was denied.
units.literal: In the first year of Tonghe he requested retirement on grounds of age, but was not permitted.

units.zh: 進《尚書·無逸篇》以諫，太后聞而嘉獎。
units.en: He submitted the "Against Dissipation" chapter of the Documents as a remonstrance; when the empress dowager heard of it, she praised him.
units.literal: He presented the "Against Dissipation" chapter of the Documents to remonstrate; the empress dowager heard of it and commended him.

units.zh: 二年秋，詔修諸嶺路，昉發民夫二十萬，一日畢功。
units.en: That autumn in the second year, when an edict ordered repairs to the mountain passes, Fang drafted two hundred thousand laborers and finished the work in a single day.
units.literal: In the autumn of the second year an edict ordered repair of the various mountain passes; Fang mobilized two hundred thousand laborers and completed the work in a single day.

units.zh: 是時，昉與韓德讓、耶律斜軫相友善，同心輔政，整析蠹弊，知無不言，務在息民薄賦，以故法度修明，朝無異議。
units.en: At this time Fang was close to Han Derang and Yelu Xiezhen; working in concert they helped govern the realm, rooted out entrenched abuses, and spoke frankly on every matter they knew; their aim was to give the people respite and lighten taxes, so that statutes were kept in good order and the court heard no dissent.
units.literal: At this time Fang was on friendly terms with Han Derang and Yelu Xiezhen; together they assisted in government, sorted out corrupt abuses, and spoke out on whatever they knew; their aim was to give the people rest and lighten levies, and for this reason the laws were well ordered and the court had no dissenting voices.

units.zh: 八年，復請致政。
units.en: In the eighth year he again asked to retire from office.
units.literal: In the eighth year he again requested to relinquish office.

units.zh: 詔入朝免拜，賜几杖，太后遣閣門使李從訓持詔勞問，令常居南京，封鄭國公。
units.en: He was ordered, when coming to court, to be excused from bowing and was granted a folding stool and staff; the empress dowager sent the gate commissioner Li Congxun with an edict to comfort and inquire after him, directed that he make his permanent home at Nanjing, and enfeoffed him as Duke of Zheng.
units.literal: An edict ordered that on entering court he be excused from bowing, and granted him a folding stool and staff; the empress dowager sent Gate Commissioner Li Congxun with an edict to comfort and inquire after him, ordered that he permanently reside at Nanjing, and enfeoffed him as Duke of Zheng.

units.zh: 初，晉國公主建佛寺於南京，上許賜額。
units.en: Earlier the Princess of Jin had built a Buddhist temple at Nanjing, and the emperor had agreed to bestow an imperial inscription for its plaque.
units.literal: Earlier the Princess of Jin had built a Buddhist temple at Nanjing, and the emperor had agreed to grant it an imperial plaque inscription.

units.zh: 昉奏曰：「詔書悉罪無名寺院。
units.en: Fang submitted a memorial saying, "Imperial edicts have condemned every unlicensed monastery.
units.literal: Fang memorialized, saying: "Edicts have condemned in full all nameless monasteries.

units.zh: 今以主請賜額，不惟違前詔，恐此風愈熾。」
units.en: To grant a plaque now simply because the princess asks would not only violate those earlier orders but would, I fear, only fan this trend."
units.literal: Now to grant a plaque inscription at the princess's request not only violates the earlier edict but I fear this practice will grow ever more rampant."

units.zh: 上從之。
units.en: The emperor accepted his view.
units.literal: The emperor followed his advice.

units.zh: 表進所撰《實錄》二十卷，手詔褒之，加政事令，賜帛六百匹。
units.en: He presented in a memorial the twenty-scroll Veritable Records he had compiled; the emperor answered with a handwritten commendation, promoted him to chief administrator, and granted six hundred bolts of silk.
units.literal: He presented in a memorial the twenty scrolls of the Veritable Records he had compiled; the emperor wrote a commendation in his own hand, added the title Chief Administrator, and granted six hundred bolts of silk.

units.zh: 九年，薦韓德讓自代，不從。
units.en: In the ninth year he recommended Han Derang to succeed him, but the throne did not agree.
units.literal: In the ninth year he recommended Han Derang to replace himself, but the request was not granted.

units.zh: 上以昉年老苦寒，賜貂皮衾褥，許乘輦入朝。
units.en: Seeing that Fang was old and suffering in the bitter cold, the emperor gave him a sable quilt and bedding and allowed him to come to court by palanquin.
units.literal: Because Fang was old and the cold was bitter, the emperor granted him a sable fur quilt and mattress and permitted him to enter court by palanquin.

units.zh: 病劇，遣翰林學士張幹就第授中京留守，加尚父。
units.en: When his illness grew grave, the emperor sent the Hanlin academician Zhang Gan to his home to appoint him Zhongjing retention commissioner and add the honorific Father of the State.
units.literal: When his illness grew severe, he sent Hanlin Academician Zhang Gan to his residence to appoint him Zhongjing retention commissioner and add the honorific Father of the State.

units.zh: 卒，年七十五。
units.en: He died at the age of seventy-five.
units.literal: He died at the age of seventy-five.

units.zh: 上嗟悼，輟朝二日，贈尚書令。
units.en: The emperor mourned him deeply, suspended court for two days, and posthumously appointed him Director of the Imperial Secretariat.
units.literal: The emperor sighed in grief, suspended court for two days, and posthumously appointed him Director of the Imperial Secretariat.

units.zh: 遺言戒厚葬。
units.en: In his final instructions he warned against an extravagant funeral.
units.literal: His testament warned against lavish burial.

units.zh: 恐人譽過情，自誌其墓。
units.en: Fearing that others would praise him beyond what was deserved, he composed his own tomb inscription.
units.literal: Fearing that people would praise him beyond measure, he wrote his own tomb inscription.

units.zh: 耶律賢適，字阿古真，於越魯不古之子。
units.en: Yelu Xianshi, whose courtesy name was Aguzhen, was the son of the yuyue Lubugu.
units.literal: Yelu Xianshi, courtesy name Aguzhen, was the son of Yuyue Lubugu.

units.zh: 嗜學，有大志，滑稽玩世，人莫之知。
units.en: He loved learning and harbored great ambitions, yet affected a witty, world-weary manner, and no one recognized his true capacity.
units.literal: He loved learning and had great ambitions, yet was witty and playful with the world, so that no one knew his true worth.

units.zh: 惟於越屋質器之，嘗謂人曰：「是人當國，天下幸甚。」
units.en: Only the yuyue Wuzhi valued him and once said to others, "If this man should govern the realm, the world would be most fortunate."
units.literal: Only the yuyue Wuzhi treasured him and once told others: "If this man holds the state, the realm will be greatly fortunate."

units.zh: 應歷中，朝臣多以言獲譴，賢適樂於靜退，遊獵自娛，與親朋言不及時事。
units.en: In the Yingli period many courtiers were punished for what they said; Xianshi took pleasure in quiet withdrawal, diverted himself with hunting, and in conversation with kin and friends never mentioned affairs of the day.
units.literal: During Yingli many courtiers were punished for their words; Xianshi delighted in quiet retirement, amused himself with hunting, and in speaking with kin and friends never touched on current affairs.

units.zh: 會討烏古還，擢右皮室詳穩。
units.en: On returning from the campaign against the Wugu, he was promoted to detailed commissioner of the right pishi guard.
units.literal: When he returned from campaigning against the Wugu, he was promoted to Right Pishi Detailed Commissioner.

units.zh: 景宗在藩邸，常與韓匡嗣、女裏等遊，言或刺譏，賢適勸以宜早疏絕，由是穆宗終不見疑，賢適之力也。
units.en: While Jingzong still lived in the princely residence he often went about with Han Kuangsi, Nuli, and others, and their talk sometimes turned cutting and satirical; Xianshi urged him to break off such ties early, and for this reason Muzong never came to suspect him—a service owed to Xianshi.
units.literal: When Jingzong was at the princely residence he often went about with Han Kuangsi, Nuli, and others, and their talk sometimes included barbed mockery; Xianshi urged that they should sever ties early, and thereby Muzong never came to suspect him—it was Xianshi's doing.

units.zh: 景宗立，以功加檢校太保，尋遙授寧江軍節度使，賜推忠協力功臣。
units.en: When Jingzong ascended the throne, he was made acting grand guardian for his services, then soon given the remote appointment of military commissioner of the Ningjiang army and granted the title Merit of Loyal Cooperation.
units.literal: When Jingzong took the throne, for merit he was given acting Grand Guardian, soon remotely appointed Military Commissioner of the Ningjiang Army, and granted the title Merit of Loyal Cooperation.

units.zh: 時帝初踐阼，多疑諸王或萌非望，陰以賢適為腹心，加特進同中書門下平章事。
units.en: The emperor had only just taken the throne and feared that some of the princes might harbor designs beyond their station; he secretly made Xianshi his trusted confidant and specially advanced him to grand mentor with concurrent rank as associate chief administrator of the Secretariat.
units.literal: At that time the emperor had just ascended and was suspicious that the princes might harbor improper ambitions; he secretly made Xianshi his confidant and specially advanced him to Grand Mentor with concurrent rank as Associate Chief Administrator of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 保寧二年秋，拜北院樞密使，兼侍中，賜保節功臣。
units.en: In the autumn of the second year of Baoning he was appointed north chancellery commissioner of military affairs and concurrent palace attendant, and granted the title Merit of Protecting the Realm.
units.literal: In the autumn of the second year of Baoning he was appointed North Chancellery Commissioner of Military Affairs, concurrently Palace Attendant, and granted the title Merit of Protecting the Realm.

units.zh: 三年，為西北路兵馬都部署。
units.en: In the third year he was made commander-in-chief of troops on the northwest route.
units.literal: In the third year he became Commander-in-Chief of troops on the Northwest Route.

units.zh: 賢適忠介膚敏，推誠待人，雖燕息不忘政務。
units.en: Xianshi was loyal, upright, and keenly perceptive; he dealt with others in good faith and never set state affairs aside, even in moments of leisure.
units.literal: Xianshi was loyal, upright, quick-witted, and sincere with people; even in repose he never forgot state affairs.

units.zh: 以故百司首職，罔敢偷惰，累年滯獄悉決之。
units.en: For this reason the heads of every office dared not slacken, and lawsuits that had languished for years were all brought to judgment.
units.literal: For this reason the leading offices of every department dared not be lazy, and cases stalled for years were all decided.

units.zh: 大丞相高勛、契丹行宮都部署女裏席寵放恣，及帝姨母、保母勢薰灼，一時納賂請謁，門若賈區。
units.en: Grand Chancellor Gao Xun and the Khitan mobile-palace chief deployment Nuli basked in favor and gave free rein to their desires; together with the emperor's aunt and his nurses their power blazed so hot that for a time their gates, crowded with bribes and petitioners, seemed a marketplace.
units.literal: Grand Chancellor Gao Xun and the Khitan mobile-palace chief deployment Nuli enjoyed favor and indulged in license; together with the emperor's aunt and nurses their influence blazed, and for a time those offering bribes and seeking audiences made their gates like a market quarter.

units.zh: 賢適患之，言於帝，不報；
units.en: Xianshi was troubled by this and spoke to the emperor, but received no answer;
units.literal: Xianshi was distressed by this and spoke to the emperor, but received no response;

units.zh: 以病解職，又不允，令鑄手印行事。
units.en: he asked to resign on grounds of illness, but that too was refused, and he was ordered to have an official seal cast so that he might continue to transact business.
units.literal: he sought release from office on grounds of illness, but again was not permitted and was ordered to cast an official seal to conduct affairs.

units.zh: 乾亨初，疾篤，得請。
units.en: At the beginning of Qianheng his illness became grave, and his request was finally granted.
units.literal: At the beginning of Qianheng his illness grew severe and his request was granted.

units.zh: 明年，封西平郡王，薨，年五十三。
units.en: The following year he was enfeoffed as Prince of Xiping and died at the age of fifty-three.
units.literal: The next year he was enfeoffed as Prince of Xiping and died at the age of fifty-three.

units.zh: 子觀音，大同軍節度使。
units.en: His son Guanyin became military commissioner of the Datong army.
units.literal: His son Guanyin was Military Commissioner of the Datong Army.

units.zh: 女裏，字涅烈袞，逸其氏族，補積慶宮人。
units.en: Nuli, whose courtesy name was Nieliegün, came from a clan not recorded in the sources; he was appointed a palace attendant at Jiqing Palace.
units.literal: Nuli, courtesy name Nieliegün; his clan is not recorded. He was made a palace attendant at Jiqing Palace.

units.zh: 應歷初，為習馬小底，以母憂去。
units.en: At the beginning of the Yingli reign he served as a junior horse-training attendant and left office to mourn his mother.
units.literal: At the beginning of Yingli he served as a junior horse-training attendant and left office to mourn his mother.

units.zh: 一日至雅伯山，見一巨人，惶懼走。
units.en: One day he went to Mount Yabo, saw a giant, and fled in fear.
units.literal: One day he came to Mount Yabo and saw a giant; frightened, he fled.

units.zh: 巨人止之曰：「勿懼，我地祇也。
units.en: The giant stopped him and said, "Do not fear; I am an earth spirit.
units.literal: The giant stopped him and said: "Do not fear; I am an earth spirit.

units.zh: 葬爾母於斯，當速詣闕，必貴。」
units.en: Bury your mother here, go quickly to the court, and you are certain to rise to eminence."
units.literal: Bury your mother here, and go quickly to the court—you are certain to rise to eminence."

units.zh: 女裏從之，累遷馬群侍中。
units.en: Nuli followed this counsel and rose through repeated promotions until he became Commissioner of Horse Herds.
units.literal: Nuli followed this counsel and was repeatedly promoted, eventually becoming Commissioner of Horse Herds.

units.zh: 時景宗在藩邸，以女裏出自本宮，待遇殊厚，女裏亦傾心結納。
units.en: At that time Jingzong was still in the princely residence; because Nuli came from the same palace household, he was treated with exceptional favor, and Nuli in turn devoted himself and formed close ties with him.
units.literal: At that time Jingzong was in the princely residence; because Nuli came from the same palace, he was treated with exceptional favor, and Nuli in turn devoted himself and formed close ties.

units.zh: 及穆宗遇弒，女裏奔赴景宗。
units.en: When Muzong was assassinated, Nuli rushed to Jingzong's side.
units.literal: When Muzong was assassinated, Nuli hastened to Jingzong's side.

units.zh: 是夜，集禁兵五百以衛。
units.en: That night he gathered five hundred imperial guards to protect him.
units.literal: That night he gathered five hundred forbidden troops to guard him.

units.zh: 既即位，以翼戴功，加政事令、契丹行宮都部署，賞賚甚渥，尋加守太尉。
units.en: After Jingzong took the throne, for his merit in supporting the enthronement Nuli was made chief administrator and chief deployment of the Khitan mobile palace; he was richly rewarded, and soon thereafter was further made Defender Grandee.
units.literal: After Jingzong took the throne, for his merit in supporting the enthronement Nuli was made Chief Administrator and chief deployment of the Khitan mobile palace; he was richly rewarded, and soon thereafter was further made Defender Grandee.

units.zh: 北漢主劉繼元聞女裏為上信任，遇其生日必致禮。
units.en: The Northern Han ruler Liu Jiyuan, hearing that Nuli enjoyed the emperor's trust, invariably sent gifts on his birthday.
units.literal: The Northern Han ruler Liu Jiyuan, hearing that Nuli enjoyed the emperor's trust, invariably sent gifts on his birthday.

units.zh: 女裏素貪，同列蕭阿不底亦好賄，二人相善。
units.en: Nuli was greedy by nature; his colleague Xiao Abudi was likewise fond of bribes, and the two were close.
units.literal: Nuli was by nature greedy; his colleague Xiao Abudi also loved bribes, and the two were on good terms.

units.zh: 人有氈裘為枲耳子所著者，或戲曰：「若遇女裏、阿不底，必盡取之！」
units.en: When someone's felt coat had been eaten through by pests, people would jest, "If this falls into the hands of Nuli and Abudi, they'll take every scrap of it!"
units.literal: When someone had a felt coat gnawed by hemp-seed worms, people joked, saying: "If you meet Nuli and Abudi, they will take it all!"

units.zh: 傳以為笑。
units.en: The remark passed around as a standing joke.
units.literal: The story passed around as a joke.

units.zh: 其貪猥如此。
units.en: Such was the depth of their greed and baseness.
units.literal: Such was their greedy baseness.

units.zh: 保寧末，坐私藏甲五百屬，有司方按詰，女裏袖中又得殺樞密使蕭思溫賊書，賜死。
units.en: Near the end of Baoning he was charged with privately hoarding five hundred suits of armor while the authorities were still investigating; from Nuli's sleeve they also recovered a letter from the assassin of Commissioner of Military Affairs Xiao Siwen, and he was sentenced to death.
units.literal: At the end of Baoning he was convicted of privately hoarding five hundred suits of armor while the authorities were investigating; from Nuli's sleeve they also found a letter from the assassin who had killed Commissioner of Military Affairs Xiao Siwen, and he was sentenced to death.

units.zh: 女裏善識馬，嘗行郊野，見數馬跡，指其一曰：「此奇駿也。」
units.en: Nuli had a keen eye for horses; once when traveling in the countryside he saw several sets of tracks and pointed to one, saying, "That mark belongs to an exceptional mount."
units.literal: Nuli was skilled at recognizing horses; once when traveling in the countryside he saw several sets of hoofprints and pointed to one, saying: "This is an extraordinary steed."

units.zh: 以己馬易之，果然。
units.en: He traded his own horse for the animal in question, and so it proved.
units.literal: He traded his own horse for it, and it proved so indeed.

units.zh: 郭襲，不知何郡人。
units.en: Guo Xi came from an unknown commandery.
units.literal: Guo Xi—of what commandery he came is unknown.

units.zh: 性端介，識治體。
units.en: He was upright by nature and understood the fundamentals of good government.
units.literal: His nature was upright and principled, and he understood the essentials of governance.

units.zh: 久淹外調。
units.en: For many years he languished in provincial appointments.
units.literal: For a long time he was detained in outside assignments.

units.zh: 景宗即位，召見，對稱旨，知可任以事，拜南院樞密使，尋加兼政事令。
units.en: When Jingzong came to the throne, Xi was summoned to court; his answers pleased the emperor, who saw that he could be entrusted with serious business; he was appointed south chancellery commissioner of military affairs and soon given the concurrent title of chief administrator.
units.literal: When Jingzong took the throne he was summoned for an audience; his replies accorded with the imperial will, and the emperor knew he could be entrusted with affairs; he was appointed South Chancellery Commissioner of Military Affairs and soon added the concurrent title Chief Administrator.

units.zh: 以帝數遊獵，襲上書諫曰：「昔唐高祖好獵，蘇世長言不滿十旬未足為樂，高祖即日罷，史稱其美。
units.en: Because the emperor went hunting so often, Xi submitted a memorial of remonstrance, saying, "In former times Emperor Gaozu of Tang was fond of the chase; when Su Shichang remarked that less than ten days could hardly count as pleasure, Gaozu gave it up that very day, and the historians praised him for it.
units.literal: Because the emperor frequently went hunting, Xi submitted a memorial of remonstrance, saying: "In former times Emperor Gaozu of Tang loved the hunt; Su Shichang said that less than ten days was not enough to count as pleasure, and Gaozu stopped the same day—history praises this.

units.zh: 伏念聖祖創業艱難，修德布政，宵旰不懈。
units.en: I reflect that our sacred founder built the realm through hardship, cultivated virtue, spread good government, and from dawn to dusk never slackened his efforts.
units.literal: I reflect that the sacred ancestor founded the enterprise amid hardship, cultivated virtue and spread governance, and from dawn to dusk never slackened.

units.zh: 穆宗逞無厭之欲，不恤國事，天下愁怨。
units.en: Emperor Muzong gave free rein to insatiable desires and neglected the affairs of state, until the realm groaned with resentment.
units.literal: Emperor Muzong indulged insatiable desires and did not care for state affairs, and the realm groaned in resentment.

units.zh: 陛下繼統，海內翕然望中興之治。
units.en: When Your Majesty succeeded to the throne, the realm as one looked to a restoration of good government.
units.literal: When Your Majesty succeeded to the throne, within the seas all looked with one accord to a restoration of good government.

units.zh: 十餘年間，征伐未已，而寇賊未弭；
units.en: For more than ten years campaigns have not ceased, yet bandits and enemies remain unquelled;
units.literal: For more than ten years campaigns have not ceased, yet bandits and enemies are not pacified;

units.zh: 年谷雖登，而瘡痍未復。
units.en: though the harvest has been good, the wounds of the land are not yet healed.
units.literal: though the year's grain has been harvested, the wounds of the land are not yet healed.

units.zh: 正宜戒懼修省，以懷永圖。
units.en: This is precisely the time for vigilance, restraint, and self-examination, with a far-reaching design always in view.
units.literal: This is precisely the time for vigilance, fear, and self-examination, keeping in mind a long-range design.

units.zh: 側聞恣意遊獵，甚於往日。
units.en: I have heard, moreover, that Your Majesty now indulges in hunting more freely than ever before.
units.literal: I have heard on the side that Your Majesty indulges in hunting at will more than in former days.

units.zh: 萬一有銜橛之變，搏噬之虞，悔將何及？
units.en: Should there by any chance be an accident with the bridle or the risk of being torn by beasts, what regret could then avail?
units.literal: If by any chance there should be an accident with the bit or the danger of mauling, what regret could avail?

units.zh: 況南有強敵，伺隙而動，聞之得無生心乎？
units.en: Moreover, a powerful enemy lies to the south, watching for an opening to strike; on hearing of this, would he not take heart?
units.literal: Moreover, to the south there is a powerful enemy watching for an opening to move; on hearing of this, would he not take heart?

units.zh: 伏望陛下節從禽酣飲之樂，為生靈社稷計，則有無疆之休。」
units.en: I humbly beg Your Majesty to restrain the pleasures of the chase and deep drinking and act for the sake of the people and the altars of state; then blessing without limit will follow."
units.literal: I humbly hope Your Majesty will restrain the pleasures of following game and deep drinking, and act for the sake of the people and the altars of state; then there will be boundless blessing."

units.zh: 上覽而稱善，賜協贊功臣，拜武定軍節度使，卒。
units.en: The emperor read the memorial and praised it, granted him the title Merit of Co-assisting, appointed him military commissioner of the Wuding army, and he later died.
units.literal: The emperor read it and praised it, granted him the title Merit of Co-assisting, appointed him Military Commissioner of the Wuding Army, and he died.

units.zh: 耶律阿沒裏，字蒲鄰，遙輦嘲古可汗之四世孫。
units.en: Yelu Ameli, whose courtesy name was Pulian, was a fourth-generation descendant of the Yaolian khan Chaogu.
units.literal: Yelu Ameli, courtesy name Pulian, was a fourth-generation descendant of the Yaolian Khan Chaogu.

units.zh: 幼聰敏。
units.en: Even as a boy he was quick-witted.
units.literal: In youth he was clever.

units.zh: 保寧中，為南院宣徽使。
units.en: During Baoning he served as south chancellery commissioner of the palace directorate.
units.literal: During Baoning he was South Chancellery Commissioner of the Palace Directorate.

units.zh: 統和初，皇太后稱制，與耶律斜軫參預國論，為都統。
units.en: At the beginning of Tonghe, when the empress dowager held the regency, he joined Yelu Xiezhen in deliberating on affairs of state and was made commander-in-chief.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tonghe the empress dowager held the regency; together with Yelu Xiezhen he participated in deliberations on state affairs and was made Commander-in-Chief.

units.zh: 以征高麗功，遷北院宣徽使，加政事令。
units.en: For his services in the campaign against Goryeo he was promoted to north chancellery commissioner of the palace directorate and given the added title of chief administrator.
units.literal: For merit in the campaign against Goryeo he was transferred to North Chancellery Commissioner of the Palace Directorate and added the title Chief Administrator.

units.zh: 四年春，宋將曹彬、米信等侵燕，上親征，阿沒裏為都監，屢破敵軍。
units.en: In the spring of the fourth year the Song generals Cao Bin, Mi Xin, and others invaded Yan; the emperor took the field in person, with Ameli as chief overseer, and repeatedly routed the enemy.
units.literal: In the spring of the fourth year the Song generals Cao Bin, Mi Xin, and others invaded Yan; the emperor campaigned in person, Ameli served as chief overseer, and repeatedly defeated the enemy armies.

units.zh: 十二年，行在多盜，阿沒裏立禁捕法，盜始息。
units.en: In the twelfth year theft was rampant at the mobile palace; Ameli instituted strict prohibition and arrest measures, and the thefts finally subsided.
units.literal: In the twelfth year there were many thieves at the mobile palace; Ameli established prohibition and arrest regulations, and theft then ceased.

units.zh: 先是，叛逆之家，兄弟不知情者亦連坐。
units.en: Previously, in cases of treason, brothers who had known nothing of the plot were still punished by association.
units.literal: Previously, in families of rebels, brothers who did not know of the crime were also punished by association.

units.zh: 阿沒裏諫曰：「夫兄弟雖曰同胞，賦性各異，一行逆謀，雖不與知，輒坐以法，是刑及無罪也。
units.en: Ameli remonstrated, saying, "Brothers may share the same womb, yet their natures differ; when one commits treason, to punish even those who knew nothing is to extend the law to the innocent.
units.literal: Ameli remonstrated, saying: "Although brothers are called born of the same womb, their natures differ; when one commits treason, to punish by law even those who did not know is to extend punishment to the guiltless.

units.zh: 自今雖同居兄弟，不知情者免連坐。」
units.en: Henceforth, even among brothers living under the same roof, those who were ignorant of the crime shall be exempt from associated punishment."
units.literal: From now on, even among brothers living together, those who did not know shall be exempt from associated punishment."

units.zh: 太后嘉納，著為令。
units.en: The empress dowager praised and accepted his advice, and it was written into law.
units.literal: The empress dowager commended and accepted this, and it was written into regulation.

units.zh: 致仕，卒。
units.en: He retired from office and later died.
units.literal: He retired from office and died.

units.zh: 阿沒裏性好聚斂，每從征所掠人口，聚而建城，請為豐州，就以家奴閻貴為刺史，時議鄙之。
units.en: Ameli was by nature fond of amassing wealth; on every campaign he gathered the people taken in plunder, assembled them to build a city, asked that it be made Feng Prefecture, and appointed his household slave Yan Gui as prefect—an act widely despised at the time.
units.literal: Ameli by nature loved to amass wealth; on each campaign he gathered the population taken in plunder, assembled them to build a city, requested that it be made Feng Prefecture, and appointed his household slave Yan Gui as prefect—contemporary opinion despised this.

units.zh: 子賢哥，左夷離畢。
units.en: His son Xiange became left yilizhi.
units.literal: His son Xiange was Left Yilizhi.

units.zh: 論曰：景宗之世，人望中興，豈其勤心庶績而然，蓋承穆宗醟虐之餘，為善易見；
units.en: The historian remarks: In Jingzong's reign the people looked for a restoration of good government—was this because the emperor himself labored diligently at every task? Rather, coming after Muzong's dissipation and cruelty, even modest acts of goodness stood out plainly;
units.literal: The discussion says: In the age of Jingzong people looked to a restoration—was it because he diligently attended to the myriad tasks? Rather, coming after the dissipation and cruelty of Muzong, doing good was easy to see;

units.zh: 亦由群臣多賢，左右弼諧之力也。
units.en: it was also because so many of his ministers were worthy men, and because of the supporting counsel of those at his side.
units.literal: it was also because many ministers were worthy and the power of those at left and right who assisted and harmonized.

units.zh: 室昉進《無逸》之篇，郭襲陳諫獵之疏，阿沒裏請免同氣之坐，所謂仁人之言，其利溥哉。
units.en: Shi Fang presented the "Against Dissipation" chapter, Guo Xi submitted his memorial against excessive hunting, and Ameli asked that innocent brothers be spared associated punishment—these are what are called the words of humane men, whose benefit spreads far indeed.
units.literal: Shi Fang presented the chapter "Against Dissipation," Guo Xi set forth the memorial remonstrating against the hunt, and Ameli requested exemption from associated punishment among those of the same breath—what are called the words of a humane man, whose benefit is far-reaching indeed.

units.zh: 賢適忠介，亦近世之名臣。
units.en: Xianshi, loyal and upright, ranks among the celebrated ministers of recent times as well.
units.literal: Xianshi was loyal and upright and also a famous minister of recent times.

units.zh: 女裏貪猥，後人所當取鑒者也。
units.en: Nuli, greedy and base, is a man later generations ought to take as a warning.
units.literal: Nuli was greedy and base—a man later generations ought to take as a warning.

units.zh: 用屋質之謀，各罷兵趨上京。
units.en: Following Wuzhi's counsel, both sides disbanded their armies and marched for the Supreme Capital.
units.literal: Following Wuzhi's plan, both sides disbanded their armies and marched for the Supreme Capital.

units.zh: 加宰相室昉、宣徽使普領等恩。
units.en: Chancellor Shifang, Commissioner of the Palace Attendants Puling, and others received added honors.
units.literal: Chancellor Shifang, Commissioner of the Palace Attendants Puling, and others were granted additional favor.

units.zh: 丁亥，樞密使兼政事令室昉以年老請解兼職，詔不允。
units.en: On dinghai day Commissioner of Military Affairs and Chief Councillor Shifang, citing age, asked to be relieved of his concurrent office; the court refused.
units.literal: On dinghai day Commissioner of Military Affairs and Chief Councillor Shifang, being old, requested to be relieved of his concurrent post; an edict refused.

units.zh: 己丑，皇子隆緒生。
units.en: On jichou day Prince Longxu was born.
units.literal: On jichou day Prince Longxu was born.

units.zh: 景宗上
units.en: Jingzong, Part One
units.literal: Jingzong, Part One

units.zh: 景宗孝成康靖皇帝，諱賢，字賢寧，小字明扆。
units.en: The Emperor Jingzong, posthumous title Xiaocheng Kangjing, personal name Xian, courtesy name Xianning, childhood name Mingyi.
units.literal: Emperor Jingzong Xiaocheng Kangjing, taboo name Xian, style name Xianning, childhood name Mingyi.

units.zh: 百官上尊號曰天贊皇帝，大赦，改元保寧。
units.en: The officials submitted the honorific title Emperor Tianzan; a grand amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed to Baoning.
units.literal: The officials submitted the honorific title Emperor Tianzan, granted a grand amnesty, and changed the era name to Baoning.

units.zh: 群臣勸進，遂即皇帝位於柩前。
units.en: The ministers urged him to ascend, and he took the throne before the coffin.
units.literal: The ministers urged him to take the throne, and he thereupon ascended the imperial seat before the coffin.

units.zh: 世宗皇帝第二子，母曰懷節皇后蕭氏。
units.en: He was the second son of Emperor Shizong; his mother was Empress Huaijie of the Xiao clan.
units.literal: Second son of Emperor Shizong; his mother was Empress Huaijie, née Xiao.

units.zh: 辛卯，祭皇兄吼墓，追冊為皇太子，謚莊聖。
units.en: On xinmao day the Emperor sacrificed at the tomb of his elder brother Hou, who was posthumously enfeoffed as crown prince with the posthumous title Zhuangsheng.
units.literal: On xinmao day he sacrificed at the tomb of his elder brother Hou; Hou was posthumously enfeoffed as crown prince with posthumous title Zhuangsheng.

units.zh: 五月戊寅，立貴妃蕭氏為皇后。
units.en: In the fifth month, on wuyin day, Consort Xiao of the Xiao clan was made empress.
units.literal: In the fifth month, on wuyin day, Consort Xiao was established as empress.

units.zh: 三月庚申朔，追冊為皇太叔。
units.en: In the third month, on the gengshen new moon, Yansage was posthumously enfeoffed as Imperial Grand Uncle.
units.literal: In the third month, on the gengshen new moon, he was posthumously enfeoffed as Imperial Grand Uncle.

units.zh: 察割之亂，帝甫四歲。
units.en: During the Chaige Rebellion the Emperor was only four years old.
units.literal: At the Chaige Rebellion the Emperor was only four years old.

units.zh: 穆宗即位，養永興宮。
units.en: After Muzong ascended the throne, he was raised in Yongxing Palace.
units.literal: When Muzong took the throne, he was raised in Yongxing Palace.

units.zh: 應歷十九年春二月戊辰，入見，穆宗曰：「吾兒已成人，可付以政。」
units.en: In the nineteenth year of Yingli, on wuchen day in the second spring month, he came for an audience; Muzong said, "My son is already grown and may be entrusted with government."
units.literal: In the nineteenth year of Yingli, on wuchen day of the second spring month, he entered for audience; Muzong said, "My son is already grown and may be entrusted with government."

units.zh: 己巳，穆宗遇弒，帝率飛龍使女裏、侍中蕭思溫、南院樞密使高勛率甲騎千人馳赴。
units.en: On jisi day Muzong was assassinated; the Emperor led Flying Dragon Commissioner Nüli, Palace Attendant Xiao Siwen, and Southern Chancellery Commissioner Gao Xun at the head of a thousand armored horsemen in haste to the scene.
units.literal: On jisi day Muzong was assassinated; the Emperor led Flying Dragon Commissioner Nüli, Palace Attendant Xiao Siwen, and Southern Chancellery Commissioner Gao Xun with a thousand armored horsemen in haste to the spot.

units.zh: 三月丙戌，入上京，以蕭思溫為北院樞密使。
units.en: In the third month, on bingxu day, he entered the Supreme Capital and appointed Xiao Siwen Northern Chancellery Commissioner.
units.literal: In the third month, on bingxu day, he entered the Supreme Capital and made Xiao Siwen Northern Chancellery Commissioner.

units.zh: 二年春正月丁未，如潢河。
units.en: In the second year, on dingwei day in the first spring month, the Emperor went to the Huang River.
units.literal: In the second year, on dingwei day of the first spring month, he went to the Huang River.

units.zh: 三年春正月甲寅，右夷離畢奚底遣人獻敵烈俘，詔賜有功將士。
units.en: In the third year, on jiayin day in the first spring month, right yilijin Xidi sent men with captives taken from Dilie; an edict rewarded the officers and soldiers who had earned merit.
units.literal: In the third year, on jiayin day of the first spring month, right yilijin Xidi sent men presenting captives of Dilie; an edict granted rewards to meritorious officers and soldiers.

units.zh: 四年春二月癸亥，漢以皇子生，遣使來賀。
units.en: In the fourth year, on guihai day in the second spring month, Han sent envoys to offer congratulations on the birth of a prince.
units.literal: In the fourth year, on guihai day of the second spring month, Han, because a prince was born, sent envoys to offer congratulations.

units.zh: 五年春正月甲子，惕隱休哥伐党項，破之，以俘獲之數來上。
units.en: In the fifth year, on jiazi day in the first spring month, tithen Xiuge attacked the Tangut, routed them, and reported the number of captives taken.
units.literal: In the fifth year, on jiazi day of the first spring month, tithen Xiuge attacked the Tangut and defeated them, presenting the tally of captives.

units.zh: 六年春正月癸未，幸南京。
units.en: In the sixth year, on guiwei day in the first spring month, the Emperor visited the Southern Capital.
units.literal: In the sixth year, on guiwei day of the first spring month, he visited the Southern Capital.

units.zh: 七年春正月甲戌朔，宋遣使來賀。
units.en: In the seventh year, on the jiaxu new moon of the first spring month, Song sent envoys to offer congratulations.
units.literal: In the seventh year, on the jiaxu new moon of the first spring month, Song sent envoys to offer congratulations.

units.zh: 八年春正月癸酉，宋遣使來聘。
units.en: In the eighth year, on guiyou day in the first spring month, Song sent envoys on a diplomatic visit.
units.literal: In the eighth year, on guiyou day in the first month of spring, Song sent envoys on a visit.

units.zh: 十一月甲辰朔，行柴冊禮，祠木葉山，駐蹕鶴谷。
units.en: In the eleventh month, on the jiachen new moon, he performed the fire-wood enthronement rite, sacrificed to Mount Muye, and encamped at Crane Valley.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, on the jiachen new moon, he performed the fire-wood enthronement rite, sacrificed to Mount Muye, and halted at Crane Valley.

units.zh: 帝一日與韓匡嗣語及時事，耶律賢適止之。
units.en: One day the Emperor spoke with Han Kuangsi about current affairs, and Yelü Xianshi cut him off.
units.literal: One day the Emperor discussed current affairs with Han Kuangsi; Yelü Xianshi stopped it.

units.zh: 二月壬寅，諭史館學士，書皇后言亦稱「朕」暨「予」，著為定式。
units.en: On renyin day in the second month he instructed the Hanlin academicians that in official records the empress's pronouncements were also to use "I" — both zhen and yu — and this was established as fixed convention.
units.literal: In the second month, on renyin day, instructed Hanlin academicians that in writing the empress's words also use "I" (zhen and yu), establishing this as fixed form.

units.zh: 夏四月，幸東京，致奠於讓國皇帝及世宗廟。
units.en: That summer, in the fourth month, he visited the Eastern Capital and made offerings at the temples of the Abdication Emperor and Shizong.
units.literal: That summer, in the fourth month, he visited the Eastern Capital and offered sacrifice at the temples of the Abdication Emperor and Shizong.

units.zh: 帝悟，不復言。
units.en: The Emperor took the hint and said no more.
units.literal: The Emperor understood and spoke no more.

units.zh: 丙申，射柳祈雨。
units.en: On bingshen day the Emperor shot the willow branch to pray for rain.
units.literal: On bingshen day he shot the willow branch to pray for rain.

units.zh: 有司請以帝生日為天清節，從之。
units.en: The officials asked that the Emperor's birthday be declared the Tianqing Festival, and the request was granted.
units.literal: The officials requested that the Emperor's birthday be made the Tianqing Festival, and this was approved.

units.zh: 冬十月，東幸瑽潭。
units.en: That winter, in the tenth month, the Emperor traveled east to Congtan.
units.literal: That winter, in the tenth month, he traveled east to Congtan.

units.zh: 五月癸丑，西幸。
units.en: In the fifth month, on guichou day, the Emperor traveled west.
units.literal: In the fifth month, on guichou day, he traveled west.

units.zh: 六月，還上京。
units.en: In the sixth month the Emperor returned to the Supreme Capital.
units.literal: In the sixth month he returned to the Supreme Capital.

units.zh: 二月癸酉，東幸。
units.en: In the second month, on guiyou day, the Emperor traveled east.
units.literal: In the second month, on guiyou day, he traveled east.

units.zh: 己丑，以青牛白馬祭天地。
units.en: On jichou day the Emperor sacrificed a green ox and white horse to heaven and earth.
units.literal: On jichou day a green ox and white horse were used to sacrifice to heaven and earth.

units.zh: 己卯，祠木葉山，行再生禮。
units.en: On jimao day the Emperor sacrificed to Mount Muye and performed the rebirth rite.
units.literal: On jimao day he sacrificed to Mount Muye and performed the rebirth rite.

units.zh: 丙戌，至自東幸。
units.en: On bingxu day the Emperor returned from the eastern tour.
units.literal: On bingxu day he returned from the eastern tour.

units.zh: 六月丙子，漢遣使問起居，自是繼月而至。
units.en: In the sixth month, on bingzi day, Han sent envoys to inquire after the Emperor's health, and such missions thereafter arrived every month.
units.literal: In the sixth month, on bingzi day, Han sent envoys inquiring after the Emperor's health; from then on they came month after month.

units.zh: 八月甲戌，如秋山。
units.en: In the eighth month, on jiaxu day, the Emperor went to Autumn Mountain.
units.literal: In the eighth month, on jiaxu day, he went to Autumn Mountain.

units.zh: 壬子，幸歸化州。
units.en: On renzi day the Emperor visited Guihua Prefecture.
units.literal: On renzi day he visited Guihua Prefecture.

units.zh: 甲寅，如南京。
units.en: On jiayin day the Emperor went to the Southern Capital.
units.literal: On jiayin day he went to the Southern Capital.

units.zh: 十二月癸酉，以青牛白馬祭天地。
units.en: In the twelfth month, on guiyou day, the Emperor sacrificed a green ox and white horse to heaven and earth.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, on guiyou day, a green ox and white horse were used to sacrifice to heaven and earth.

units.zh: 秋七月，如云州。
units.en: That autumn, in the seventh month, the Emperor went to Yun Prefecture.
units.literal: That autumn, in the seventh month, went to Yun Prefecture.

units.zh: 冬十月丁亥朔，如南京。
units.en: That winter, on the dinghai new moon of the tenth month, the Emperor went to the Southern Capital.
units.literal: That winter, on the dinghai new moon of the tenth month, went to the Southern Capital.

units.zh: 庚午，禦五鳳樓觀燈。
units.en: On gengwu day the Emperor mounted the Five Phoenix Tower to view the lanterns.
units.literal: On gengwu day he mounted the Five Phoenix Tower to view the lanterns.

units.zh: 戊申，以青牛白馬祭天地。
units.en: On wushen day the Emperor sacrificed a green ox and white horse to heaven and earth.
units.literal: On wushen day a green ox and white horse were used to sacrifice to heaven and earth.

units.zh: 辛亥，幸新城。
units.en: On xinhai day the Emperor visited New City.
units.literal: On xinhai day he visited New City.

units.zh: 三月乙卯朔，復幸新城。
units.en: On the yimao new moon of the third month the Emperor again visited New City.
units.literal: In the third month, on the yimao new moon, he again visited New City.

units.zh: 冬十月丁酉，如南京。
units.en: That winter, in the tenth month on dingyou day, the Emperor went to the Southern Capital.
units.literal: That winter, in the tenth month on dingyou day, he went to the Southern Capital.

units.zh: 是月，如歸化州。
units.en: That month the Emperor went to Guihua Prefecture.
units.literal: That month he went to Guihua Prefecture.

units.zh: 庚申，獵於平地松林。
units.en: On gengshen day the Emperor hunted at Level Ground Pine Forest.
units.literal: On gengshen day he hunted at Level Ground Pine Forest.

units.zh: 冬十月乙亥朔，還上京。
units.en: That winter, on the yihai new moon of the tenth month, the Emperor returned to the Supreme Capital.
units.literal: That winter, on the yihai new moon of the tenth month, he returned to the Supreme Capital.

units.zh: 壬寅，望祠木葉山。
units.en: On renyin day the Emperor performed the full-moon sacrifice at Mount Muye.
units.literal: On renyin day he performed the full-moon sacrifice at Mount Muye.

units.zh: 丙寅，以青牛白馬祭天地。
units.en: On bingyin day the Emperor sacrificed a green ox and white horse to heaven and earth.
units.literal: On bingyin day a green ox and white horse were used to sacrifice to heaven and earth.

units.zh: 辛丑，耶律沙遣人上俘獲，以權知南京留守事韓德讓、權南京馬步軍都指揮使耶律學古、知三司事劉弘皆能安人心，捍城池，並賜詔褒獎。
units.en: On xinchou day Yelü Sha sent up prisoners; edicts commended Han Derang, acting Nanjing regent, Yelü Xuegu, acting Nanjing cavalry-and-infantry commander, and Liu Hong, director of the Three Departments, for steadying morale and holding the city.
units.literal: On xinchou day, Yelü Sha sent men presenting captives; because acting Nanjing regent Han Derang, acting Nanjing cavalry-and-infantry commander Yelü Xuegu, and Director of the Three Departments Liu Hong had all been able to steady hearts and defend the walls, edicts of praise and reward were granted to each.

units.zh: 十二月，以遼興軍節度使韓德讓為南院樞密使。
units.en: In the twelfth month Liaoxing Army Military Commissioner Han Derang was appointed Southern Court Commissioner of Military Affairs.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, Liaoxing Army Military Commissioner Han Derang was made Southern Court Commissioner of Military Affairs.

units.zh: 夏六月，以西南面招討使耶律斜軫為北院大王。
units.en: In the sixth summer month Southwest circuit pacification commissioner Yelü Xiezhen was appointed Northern Court Great King.
units.literal: In the sixth month of summer, Southwest circuit pacification commissioner Yelü Xiezhen was made Northern Court Great King.

units.zh: 穆宗下
units.en: Muzong, Part Two
units.literal: Muzong, Part Two

units.zh: 是夜，近侍小哥、盥人花哥、庖人辛古等六人反，帝遇弒，年三十九，廟號穆宗。
units.en: That night personal attendant Xiaoge, washer Huage, cook Xingu, and three others — six men in all — rose in revolt; the Emperor was assassinated at thirty-nine; his temple name was Muzong.
units.literal: That night attendants Xiaoge, washer Huage, cook Xingu, and three others — six men in all — rebelled; the Emperor met assassination at age thirty-nine; his temple name was Muzong.

units.zh: 贊曰：穆宗在位十八年，知女巫妖妄見誅，諭臣下濫刑切諫，非不明也。
units.en: The eulogy says: Muzong held the throne for eighteen years; he saw through the witch's fraud and had her killed, and he urgently warned his ministers against arbitrary punishments — he was not without understanding.
units.literal: The eulogy says: Muzong reigned eighteen years; he knew the witch's sorcery was false and had her executed, and he admonished his ministers against excessive punishment — he was not unintelligent.

units.zh: 癸亥，如潢河。
units.en: On guihai day the Emperor went to the Huang River.
units.literal: On guihai day he went to the Huang River.

units.zh: 十七年春正月庚寅朔，林牙蕭斡、郎君耶律賢適討烏古還，帝執其手，賜卮酒，授賢適右皮室詳穩。
units.en: In the seventeenth year, on the gengyin new moon of the first spring month, linya Xiao Wo and langjun Yelü Xianshi returned from suppressing the Wugu; the Emperor took Xianshi's hand, granted him a cup of wine, and made him right Pishi xiangwen.
units.literal: In the seventeenth year, on the gengyin new moon of the first month of spring, linya Xiao Wo and langjun Yelü Xianshi returned from suppressing the Wugu; the Emperor took Xianshi's hand, granted him a cup of wine, and appointed him right Pishi xiangwen.

units.zh: 重熙二十一年，謚曰孝安敬正皇帝。
units.en: In the twenty-first year of Chongxi he was posthumously titled Emperor Xia'an Jingzheng.
units.literal: In the twenty-first year of Chongxi his posthumous title was Emperor Xia'an Jingzheng.

units.zh: 十四年春正月戊寅朔，奉安神纛。
units.en: In the fourteenth year, on the wuyin new moon of the first spring month, the spirit canopy was installed and enshrined.
units.literal: In the fourteenth year, on the wuyin new moon of the first month of spring, the spirit canopy was installed and enshrined.

units.zh: 十五年春正月乙卯，以樞密使雅裏斯為行軍都統，虎軍詳穩楚思為行軍都監，益以突呂不部軍三百，合諸部兵討之。
units.en: In the fifteenth year, on yimao day in the first spring month, Palace Secretariat Commissioner Yalisi was made campaign commander-in-chief and Tiger Army xiangwen Chusi campaign deputy commander; three hundred Tulubu troops were added, and combined forces from the tribes were sent to suppress the rebellion.
units.literal: In the fifteenth year, on yimao day of the first month of spring, Palace Secretariat Commissioner Yalisi was made campaign commander-in-chief and Tiger Army xiangwen Chusi was made campaign deputy commander; three hundred Tulubu troops were added, and forces from the various tribes were combined to suppress the rebels.

units.zh: 十六年春正月丁卯朔，被酒，不受賀。
units.en: In the sixteenth year, on the dingmao new moon of the first spring month, the Emperor was drunk and refused congratulations.
units.literal: In the sixteenth year, on the dingmao new moon of the first month of spring, he was drunk and declined congratulations.

units.zh: 十八年春正月乙酉朔，宴於宮中，不受賀。
units.en: In the eighteenth year, on the yiyou new moon of the first spring month, the Emperor held a banquet in the palace and declined congratulations.
units.literal: In the eighteenth year, on the yiyou new moon of the first month of spring, he held a banquet in the palace and declined congratulations.

units.zh: 十九年春正月乙卯朔，宴宮中，不受賀。
units.en: In the nineteenth year, on the yimao new moon of the first spring month, he feasted in the palace and refused the customary congratulations.
units.literal: In the nineteenth year, on the yimao new moon of the first month of spring, he held a banquet in the palace and did not accept congratulations.

units.zh: 己巳，如懷州，獵獲熊，歡飲方醉，馳還行宮。
units.en: On jisi day he went to Huai Prefecture, hunted down a bear, drank himself merry until he was drunk, then galloped back to the traveling palace.
units.literal: On jisi day he went to Huai Prefecture, hunted and captured a bear, drank joyfully until drunk, and galloped back to the mobile palace.

units.zh: 後附葬懷陵。
units.en: He was later buried by attachment at Huai Mausoleum.
units.literal: Later he was attached in burial at Huai Mausoleum.

units.zh: 而荒耽於酒，畋獵無厭。
units.en: Yet he gave himself over to drink and hunted without end.
units.literal: Yet he abandoned himself to wine and hunted without satiety.

units.zh: 賞罰無章，朝政不視，而嗜殺不已。
units.en: Reward and punishment followed no consistent rule; he ignored the business of government, yet his appetite for bloodshed never slackened.
units.literal: Rewards and punishments had no fixed rule; he would not look to court affairs, yet he never ceased killing.

units.zh: 乙巳，詔太尉化哥曰：「朕醉中處事有乖，無得曲從。
units.en: On yisi day he issued an edict to Grand Preceptor Huage: "When I decide matters in drunkenness and go wrong, you must not simply defer to me.
units.literal: On yisi day he issued an edict to Grand Preceptor Huage, saying, "When I handle affairs while drunk and go astray, you must not simply comply.

units.zh: 酒解，可覆奏。」
units.en: Once I am sober, you may submit the matter again."
units.literal: When the wine has cleared, you may resubmit your memorial."

units.zh: 六月丙午朔，獵於玉山，竟月忘返。
units.en: On the bingwu new moon of the sixth month he hunted at Jade Mountain and did not return for the entire month.
units.literal: In the sixth month, on the bingwu new moon, he hunted at Jade Mountain and forgot to return for the whole month.

units.zh: 五月甲申，以歲旱，泛舟於池禱雨；
units.en: In the fifth month, on jiashen day, because the year was drought-stricken, he rowed a boat on a pool to pray for rain.
units.literal: In the fifth month, on jiashen day, because the year was drought-stricken, he rowed a boat on a pool to pray for rain.

units.zh: 不雨，舍舟立水中而禱，俄頃乃雨。
units.en: When no rain came, he left the boat, stood in the water to pray, and rain fell shortly afterward.
units.literal: When no rain came, he left the boat, stood in the water to pray, and rain fell shortly afterward.

units.zh: 六月己未，支解雉人壽哥、念古，殺鹿人四十四人。
units.en: In the sixth month, on jiwei day, the pheasant-keepers Shouge and Nianggu were dismembered and forty-four deer-keepers were put to death.
units.literal: In the sixth month, on jiwei day, the pheasant-keepers Shouge and Nianggu were dismembered and forty-four deer-keepers were killed.

units.zh: 戊辰，支解鹿人沒答、海裏等七人於野，封土識其地。
units.en: On wuchen day seven deer-keepers, including Moda and Haili, were dismembered in the open country, and mounds of earth were raised to mark the spot.
units.literal: On wuchen day the deer-keepers Moda, Haili, and five others were dismembered in the wild; earth was piled to mark the place.

units.zh: 三月癸酉，近侍東兒進匕箸不時，手刃刺之。
units.en: In the third month, on guiyou day, the attendant Dong'er presented chopsticks at the wrong moment, and the Emperor stabbed him to death with his own blade.
units.literal: In the third month, on guiyou day, the attendant Dong'er presented chopsticks at the wrong moment and was stabbed to death by the Emperor's own hand.

units.zh: 十二月辛未，手殺饔人海裏，復臠之。
units.en: In the twelfth month, on xinwei day, he personally killed the cook Haili and then butchered the corpse.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, on xinwei day, he personally killed the cook Haili and then butchered the body.

units.zh: 己巳，如老林東濼。
units.en: On jisi day the Emperor went to Old Forest East Marsh.
units.literal: On jisi day he went to Old Forest East Marsh.

units.zh: 秋七月壬辰，以酒脯祀黑山。
units.en: That autumn, in the seventh month on renchen day, the Emperor sacrificed wine and dried meat to Black Mountain.
units.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on renchen day, wine and dried meat were used to sacrifice to Black Mountain.

units.zh: 丁未，還宮。
units.en: On dingwei day the Emperor returned to the palace.
units.literal: On dingwei day he returned to the palace.

units.zh: 乙卯，錄囚。
units.en: On yimao day the Emperor reviewed prisoners.
units.literal: On yimao day prisoners were reviewed.

units.zh: 上東幸，甲寅，以獲鴨，除鷹坊刺面、腰斬之刑，復其徭役。
units.en: The Emperor traveled east; on jiayin day, because ducks had been taken, the hawkery punishments of facial tattooing and waist-cutting were remitted and corvée duties were restored.
units.literal: The Emperor went east on a tour; on jiayin day, because ducks had been taken, the hawkery punishments of facial tattooing and waist-cutting were remitted and corvée duties were restored.

units.zh: 甲申，微行市中，賜酒家銀絹。
units.en: On jiashen day the Emperor walked incognito through the market and rewarded a wine shop with silver and silk.
units.literal: On jiashen day he walked incognito through the market and rewarded a wine shop with silver and silk.

units.zh: 三月己巳，東幸。
units.en: In the third month, on jisi day, the Emperor traveled east.
units.literal: In the third month, on jisi day, he went east on a tour.

units.zh: 秋七月壬午，諭有司：凡行幸之所，必高立標識，令民勿犯，違以死論。
units.en: That autumn, in the seventh month on renwu day, officials were instructed that wherever the Emperor traveled tall markers must be erected and the people forbidden to trespass, on pain of death.
units.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on renwu day, officials were instructed: wherever the Emperor traveled, tall markers must be erected and the people forbidden to trespass; violators were to be sentenced to death.

units.zh: 冬十月庚辰，漢主有母喪，遣使賻吊。
units.en: That winter, in the tenth month on gengchen day, the ruler of Han was in mourning for his mother, and the Emperor sent envoys with condolence gifts.
units.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on gengchen day, the ruler of Han was in mourning for his mother, and envoys were sent with condolence gifts.

units.zh: 二月甲子，高勛奏宋將城益津關，請以偏師擾之，上從之。
units.en: In the second month, on jiazi day, Gao Xun reported that Song generals were fortifying Yijin Pass and asked that a flanking force be sent to harass them; the Emperor assented.
units.literal: In the second month, on jiazi day, Gao Xun memorialized that Song generals were fortifying Yijin Pass and asked that a flanking force be sent to harass them; the Emperor assented.

units.zh: 秋八月辛酉，生日，以政事令阿不底病亟，不受賀。
units.en: That autumn, in the eighth month on xinyou day, his birthday, because Chief Councillor Abudi was gravely ill, the Emperor declined congratulations.
units.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, on xinyou day, his birthday, because Chief Councillor Abudi was gravely ill, he declined congratulations.

units.zh: 庚子，司天臺奏月當食不虧，上以為祥，歡飲達旦。
units.en: On gengzi day the Observatory reported that the moon should have been eclipsed but was not obscured; the Emperor took this as an auspicious sign and drank in celebration until dawn.
units.literal: On gengzi day the Observatory reported that the moon should have been eclipsed but was not obscured; the Emperor took this as an auspicious sign and rejoiced in drink until dawn.

units.zh: 己亥，觀燈於市。
units.en: On jihai day the Emperor viewed lanterns in the market.
units.literal: On jihai day he viewed lanterns in the market.

units.zh: 三月甲申朔，如潢河。
units.en: On the jiashen new moon of the third month the Emperor went to the Huang River.
units.literal: In the third month, on the jiashen new moon, he went to the Huang River.

units.zh: 乙酉，獲鴐鵝，祭天地。
units.en: On yiyou day swan-geese were taken and the Emperor sacrificed to heaven and earth.
units.literal: On yiyou day swan-geese were taken and heaven and earth were sacrificed to.

units.zh: 乙未，南院樞密使兼政事令郭襲上書諫畋獵，嘉納之。
units.en: On yiwei day Southern Court Commissioner of Military Affairs and Chief Councillor Guo Xi memorialized against the hunt, and the counsel was praised and heeded.
units.literal: On yiwei day, Southern Court Commissioner of Military Affairs and Chief Councillor Guo Xi submitted a memorial remonstrating against hunting; it was praised and accepted.

units.zh: 是月，以南院樞密使郭襲為武定軍節度使。
units.en: That month Southern Court Commissioner of Military Affairs Guo Xi was appointed Wuding Army Military Commissioner.
units.literal: That month, Southern Court Commissioner of Military Affairs Guo Xi was made Wuding Army Military Commissioner.

units.zh: 善郭襲之諫，納而不用；
units.en: He praised Guo Xi's remonstrance, accepted it in word but ignored it in deed;
units.literal: He approved Guo Xi's remonstrance, accepted it but did not use it;

units.zh: 趙質，字景道，遼相思溫之裔。
units.en: Zhao Zhi, styled Jingdao, was a descendant of Siwen, a chancellor of the Liao.
units.literal: Zhao Zhi, style name Jingdao, was a descendant of Siwen, chancellor of the Liao.

units.zh: 三月甲戌，於越休哥奏宋遣曹彬、崔彥進、米信由雄州道，田重進飛狐道，潘美、楊繼業雁門道來侵，岐溝、涿州、固安、新城皆陷。
units.en: In the third month, on jiaxu day, yuyue Xiuge reported that Song had sent Cao Bin, Cui Yanjin, and Mi Xin by the Xiongzhou route, Tian Chongjin by the Feihu route, and Pan Mei and Yang Jiye by the Yanmen route to invade; Qigou, Zhuo Prefecture, Gu'an, and Xincheng had all fallen.
units.literal: In the third month, on jiaxu day, yuyue Xiuge memorialized that Song had sent Cao Bin, Cui Yanjin, and Mi Xin by the Xiongzhou route, Tian Chongjin by the Feihu route, and Pan Mei and Yang Jiye by the Yanmen route to invade; Qigou, Zhuo Prefecture, Gu'an, and Xincheng had all fallen.

units.zh: 宋將曹彬、米信北渡拒馬河，與於越休哥對壘，挑戰，南北列營長六七里。
units.en: Song generals Cao Bin and Mi Xin crossed the Juma River to the north and faced yuyue Xiuge in camp, challenging battle; the opposing camps stretched six or seven li north and south.
units.literal: Song generals Cao Bin and Mi Xin crossed north over the Juma River and faced yuyue Xiuge in camp, challenging battle; north and south the camps stretched six or seven li.

units.zh: 五月庚午，遼師與曹彬、米信戰於歧溝關，大敗之，追至拒馬河，溺死者不可勝紀。
units.en: In the fifth month, on gengwu day, the Liao army fought Cao Bin and Mi Xin at Qigou Pass and crushed them, pursuing to the Juma River; the drowned were beyond counting.
units.literal: In the fifth month, on gengwu day, the Liao army fought Cao Bin and Mi Xin at Qigou Pass and routed them, pursuing to the Juma River; those who drowned were beyond counting.

units.zh: 以上將既變，乃俯首聽命，遂連署降表，令中門使高勛賫送敵帳，軍士解甲，舉聲慟哭。
units.en: With the commander already set on treason, they could only bow and obey. A joint surrender memorial was drawn up and sent to the enemy camp by Inner Gate Commissioner Gao Xun. The troops laid down their arms and wept aloud.
units.literal: Because the supreme commander had already changed his mind, they bowed their heads and obeyed. They then jointly signed a surrender memorial, had Inner Gate Commissioner Gao Xun carry it to the enemy camp, and the soldiers doffed their armor and broke into wailing cries.

units.zh: 庚午，以宣徽使阿沒裏家奴閻貴為豐州刺史。
units.en: On gengwu day Yan Gui, a household slave of palace attendant Amoli, was appointed prefect of Feng Prefecture.
units.literal: On gengwu day household slave Yan Gui of Palace Attendant Amoli was made prefect of Feng Prefecture.

units.zh: 既廟號太祖，百代不遷，每遇禘祫，位居東向之尊，自代祖元皇帝、高祖、太宗已下，列聖子孫，各序昭穆南北相向，合食於前。
units.en: With the temple name Grand Ancestor, his place would never be moved; at every di or collective sacrifice he held the seat of honor facing east. From the Yuan Emperor of Dai through the High Ancestor and Great Ancestor and below, successive imperial descendants were arranged in zhao-mu order north and south, sharing the feast before him.
units.literal: Since his temple title was Grand Ancestor, for a hundred generations he would not be moved; whenever di and he/xia sacrifices occurred he held the seat of honor facing east; from the Yuan Emperor, dynastic ancestor of Dai, down through the High Ancestor and Great Ancestor, successive sage descendants were each arranged in zhao and mu order facing north and south, and dined together before him.

units.zh: 聖朝中興，重修宗廟，今太廟見饗高祖、太宗、懿宗、昭宗、獻祖、太祖、莊宗七廟，太祖景皇帝在祧廟之數，不列廟饗。
units.en: After the dynasty's revival the ancestral shrines were rebuilt; the Imperial Temple now served seven halls—the High Ancestor, Great Ancestor, Yizong, Zhaozong, Xianzu, Taizu, and Zhuangzong—while Grand Ancestor Emperor Jing was relegated to the distant-lineage shrine and no longer received regular temple offerings.
units.literal: When the sacred court restored the dynasty and rebuilt the ancestral temples, the Imperial Ancestral Temple now offers sacrifices to seven temples: the High Ancestor, Great Ancestor, Yizong, Zhaozong, Xianzu, Taizu, and Zhuangzong. The Grand Ancestor Emperor Jing is counted among the distant ancestral temples and is not listed for temple sacrifice.

units.zh: 將來禘禮，若奉高祖居東向之尊，則禘饗不及於太祖、代祖；
units.en: If the upcoming di rite placed the High Ancestor in the seat of honor facing east, the di offering would not include the Grand Ancestor or the Dai ancestor;
units.literal: For the upcoming di ritual, if the High Ancestor were placed in the seat of honor facing east, the di offering would not reach the Grand Ancestor and the Dai ancestor;

units.zh: 宜立唐高祖、太宗及莊宗、明宗、閔帝五廟。」
units.en: Five temples should be established to Tang's High Ancestor, Great Ancestor, Zhuangzong, Mingzong, and Emperor Min."
units.literal: Five temples should be established to Tang's High Ancestor, Great Ancestor, and Zhuangzong, Mingzong, and Emperor Min."

units.zh: 高祖、太宗與其後暨莊宗、明宗，凡六主在清化裏之寢宮，祭前二日，以殿中傘扇二十，迎置新廟以享祀。
units.en: The High Ancestor, Great Ancestor, and their empresses together with Zhuangzong and Mingzong—six tablets in the sleeping palace at Qinghua Lane; two days before the sacrifice, twenty palace umbrellas and fans welcome and install them in the new temple for the offering.
units.literal: The High Ancestor, Great Ancestor, and their empresses together with Zhuangzong and Mingzong—six tablets in all in the sleeping palace at Qinghua Lane; two days before the sacrifice, twenty palace umbrellas and fans are used to welcome and install them in the new temple for the offering.

units.zh: 五帝五後，凡十主，未遷者六，未立者四，未謚者三。
units.en: Five emperors and five empresses—ten spirit tablets in all: six not yet moved, four not yet established, three not yet given posthumous titles.
units.literal: Five emperors and five empresses—ten spirit tablets in all: six not yet moved, four not yet established, three not yet given posthumous titles.

units.zh: 三月丁未，以飛龍使女裏為契丹行宮都部署。
units.en: In the third month, on dingwei day, Flying Dragon Commissioner Nüli was appointed chief steward of the Khitan traveling palace.
units.literal: In the third month, on dingwei day, Flying Dragon Commissioner Nüli was made Khitan traveling palace chief steward.

units.zh: 從宣徽使耶律阿沒裏征高麗還，改北面林牙。
units.en: Following Imperial Clan Commissioner Yelü Amoli on the campaign against Goryeo, on his return he was transferred to Northern Division Linya.
units.literal: Following Imperial Clan Commissioner Yelü Amoli on the campaign against Goryeo, on his return he was changed to Northern Division Linya.

units.zh: 秋七月辛丑，漢主承鈞殂，子繼元立，來告，遣使吊祭。
units.en: On xinchou day in the seventh autumn month Han's ruler Liu Chengjun died and his son Liu Jiyuan succeeded; when Han reported the death, the court sent envoys to offer condolences and perform the mourning rites.
units.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinchou day, Han's ruler Chengjun died and his son Jiyuan succeeded; Han sent word, and envoys were dispatched to mourn and sacrifice.

units.zh: 二月甲寅，漢劉繼元嗣立，遣使乞封冊。
units.en: On jiayin day in the second month Liu Jiyuan succeeded in Han and sent envoys begging investiture and a patent of enfeoffment.
units.literal: In the second month, on jiayin day, Liu Jiyuan of Han succeeded to the throne and sent envoys requesting investiture.

units.zh: 辛酉，遣韓知範冊為皇帝。
units.en: On xinyou day Han Zhifan was sent to invest him as emperor.
units.literal: On xinyou day Han Zhifan was dispatched to invest him as emperor.

units.zh: 壬申，遣翰林承旨邢抱樸、三司使李嗣、給事中劉京、政事舍人張幹、南京副留守吳浩分決諸道滯獄。
units.en: On renshen day Hanlin Academician Xing Baopu, Three Departments commissioner Li Si, Supervising Secretary Liu Jing, administrative secretary Zhang Gan, and Nanjing vice regent Wu Hao were sent to clear backlogged cases across the circuits.
units.literal: On renshen day Hanlin Academician Xing Baopu, Three Departments commissioner Li Si, supervisory censor Liu Jing, administrative secretary Zhang Gan, and Nanjing vice regent Wu Hao were dispatched to separately decide delayed cases of the various circuits.

units.zh: 耶律解裏耶律拔裏得耶律朔古耶律魯不古趙延壽高模翰趙思溫耶律漚裏思張礪
units.en: Yelu Jieli, Yelu Balide, Yelu Shuogu, Yelu Lubugu, Zhao Yanshou, Gao Mohan, Zhao Siwen, Yelu Oulisi, and Zhang Li
units.literal: Yelu Jieli, Yelu Balide, Yelu Shuogu, Yelu Lubugu, Zhao Yanshou, Gao Mohan, Zhao Siwen, Yelu Oulisi, Zhang Li

units.zh: 耶律魯不古，字信寧，太祖從侄也。
units.en: Yelu Lubugu, whose courtesy name was Xinning, was a paternal cousin of Emperor Taizu.
units.literal: Yelu Lubugu, courtesy name Xinning, was a younger cousin of Taizu on the father's side.

units.zh: 初，太祖制契丹國字，魯不古以贊成功，授林牙、監修國史。
units.en: When Taizu first devised the Khitan national script, Lubugu helped bring the project to completion and was appointed linya and supervisor of the national history.
units.literal: At first, when Taizu devised the Khitan national script, Lubugu assisted in completing the work and was appointed linya and supervisor of compiling the national history.

units.zh: 天祿中，拜於越。
units.en: During the Tianlu era he was made yuyue.
units.literal: During the Tianlu era he was appointed yuyue.

units.zh: 六年，為北院大王。
units.en: In the sixth year he became Great King of the Northern Court.
units.literal: In the sixth year he became Great King of the Northern Court.

units.zh: 後率偏師，為西南邊大詳穩，從伐党項有功。
units.en: Later he led a detached force, became great xianwen on the southwestern frontier, and distinguished himself in campaigns against the Tangut.
units.literal: Later he led a detached column, served as great xianwen of the southwestern frontier, and rendered merit in campaigns against the Tangut.

units.zh: 帝親率師往援，魯不古從擊唐將張敬達於太原北，敗之。
units.en: The emperor led the army in person to relieve him; Lubugu joined the attack on the Tang general Zhang Jingda north of Taiyuan and routed him.
units.literal: The emperor personally led the army to the rescue; Lubugu followed and struck the Tang general Zhang Jingda north of Taiyuan and defeated him.

units.zh: 會同初，從討党項，俘獲最諸將，師還。
units.en: Early in the Huitong era he took part in the campaign against the Tangut; among the generals his haul of prisoners was the greatest, and then the army returned.
units.literal: At the beginning of Huitong he followed the campaign against the Tangut; his captives were the most among the generals, and the army returned.

units.zh: 終年五十五。
units.en: He died at the age of fifty-five.
units.literal: He died at the age of fifty-five.

units.zh: 會河東節度使石敬瑭為其主所討，遣人求援，魯不古導送於朝，如其請。
units.en: When the Hedong military governor Shi Jingtang was attacked by his own ruler and sent envoys to seek help, Lubugu escorted them to court and the plea was granted as requested.
units.literal: When Hedong military governor Shi Jingtang was attacked by his sovereign and sent men to seek aid, Lubugu guided the envoys to court and the request was granted as he asked.

units.zh: 〈（《契丹國志》引《紀異錄》云：契丹主德光常晝寢，夢一神人花冠美姿容，輜梅甚盛，忽自天而下，衣白衣，佩金帶，執钅骨钅朵，有異人十二隨其後，內一黑兔入德光懷而失之。
units.en: (The 《Khitan State Annals》 cites the 《Record of Strange Events》: The Khitan ruler Deguang often napped by day and dreamed of a divine man with a flowered crown and beautiful countenance, with a very splendid covered carriage, who suddenly descended from Heaven, wore white robes, bore a golden belt, and grasped a mace. Twelve strange men followed behind him, and among them a black rabbit entered Deguang's bosom and vanished.
units.literal: (The Khitan State Annals cites the Record of Strange Events: The Khitan ruler Deguang often napped by day and dreamed of a divine man with a flowered crown and beautiful countenance, with a very splendid covered carriage, who suddenly descended from Heaven, wore white robes, bore a golden belt, and grasped a mace; twelve strange men followed behind him, and among them a black rabbit entered Deguang's bosom and was lost.

units.zh: 神人語德光曰：「石郎使人喚汝，汝須去。」
units.en: The divine man said to Deguang: "Master Shi has sent men to summon you. You must go."
units.literal: The divine man said to Deguang: "Master Shi has sent men to summon you; you must go."

units.zh: 及重圍晉陽，帝遣心腹何福輕騎求援北蕃，蕃主自將諸部赴之。
units.en: When Jinyang was heavily besieged, the Emperor sent his trusted man He Fu with light cavalry to seek aid from the northern tribes. The Khitan ruler personally led his tribes to come.
units.literal: When Jinyang was heavily besieged, the Emperor sent his trusted man He Fu with light cavalry to seek aid from the northern barbarians; the barbarian ruler personally led the various tribes to come.

units.zh: 未浹旬，唐石敬瑭反於河東，為後唐張敬達所敗，亟遣趙瑩持表重賂，許割燕雲，求兵為援，契丹主曰：「我非為石郎興師，乃奉天帝敕使也。」）〉
units.en: Before ten days had passed, Tang's Shi Jingtang rebelled in Hedong, was defeated by Later Tang's Zhang Jingda, and urgently sent Zhao Ying with a memorial and heavy bribes, promising to cede Yan and Yun and seeking troops as aid. The Khitan ruler said, "I do not raise troops for Master Shi. I obey the Heavenly Emperor's command.".)〉
units.literal: Before ten days had passed, Tang's Shi Jingtang rebelled in Hedong, was defeated by Later Tang's Zhang Jingda, and urgently sent Zhao Ying with a memorial and heavy bribes, promising to cede Yan and Yun and seeking troops as aid; the Khitan ruler said, "I do not raise troops for Master Shi; I obey the Heavenly Emperor's command.".)〉

units.zh: 是日，帝言於契丹主，願以雁門已北及幽州之地為戎王壽，仍約歲輸帛三十萬，戎王許之。
units.en: That day the Emperor spoke to the Khitan ruler, offering the lands north of Yanmen and Youzhou as a gift for the Khitan ruler's longevity and agreeing to deliver three hundred thousand bolts of silk yearly. The Khitan ruler consented.
units.literal: That day the Emperor spoke to the Khitan ruler, wishing to give the lands north of Yanmen and Youzhou as a gift for the Rong king's longevity, and also agreed to deliver three hundred thousand bolts of silk yearly; the Rong king consented.

units.zh: 覺告其母，母忽之，不以為異。
units.en: When he awoke he told his mother. She dismissed it and did not regard it as strange.
units.literal: When he awoke he told his mother; his mother dismissed it and did not regard it as strange.

units.zh: 矧今中原無主，四海未寧，茫茫生民，若墜塗炭。
units.en: Moreover, now the central plains have no ruler, the four seas are not at peace, and the vast living people are as if falling into mud and fire.
units.literal: Moreover, now the central plains have no ruler, the four seas are not at peace, and the vast living people are as if falling into mud and fire.

units.zh: 況萬幾不可以暫廢，大寶不可以久虛，拯溺救焚，當在此日。
units.en: How much more may the myriad affairs of state not be briefly abandoned, nor the great treasure long left vacant. To rescue the drowning and save from burning must be done on this day.
units.literal: How much more may the myriad affairs not be briefly abandoned, nor the great treasure long left vacant—to rescue the drowning and save from burning must be on this day.

units.zh: 爾有庇民之德，格於上下；
units.en: You have the virtue of sheltering the people, reaching to above and below;
units.literal: You have the virtue of sheltering the people, reaching to above and below;

units.zh: 爾有戡難之勛，光於區宇；
units.en: you have the merit of quelling hardship, shining throughout the realm;
units.literal: you have the merit of quelling hardship, shining throughout the realm;

units.zh: 爾有無私之行，通乎神明；
units.en: you have selfless conduct, penetrating to the spirits;
units.literal: you have selfless conduct, penetrating to the spirits;

units.zh: 爾有不言之信，彰乎兆庶。
units.en: you have unspoken faithfulness, manifest among the myriad people.
units.literal: you have unspoken faithfulness, manifest among the myriad people.

units.zh: 予懋乃德，嘉乃丕績。
units.en: I exalt your virtue and praise your great achievements.
units.literal: I exalt your virtue and praise your great achievements.

units.zh: 天之歷數在爾躬，是用命爾，當踐皇極。
units.en: Heaven's succession rests on your person. Therefore I command you to ascend the imperial throne.
units.literal: Heaven's succession rests on your person; therefore I command you to ascend the imperial pinnacle.

units.zh: 仍以爾自茲並土，首建義旗，宜以國號曰晉。
units.en: Moreover, because you in Bing province first raised the banner of righteousness, the state name shall be Jin.
units.literal: Moreover, because you from this time in Bing province first raised the banner of righteousness, the state name should be called Jin.

units.zh: 朕永與為父子之邦，保山河之誓。
units.en: I shall forever be with you a realm bound as father and son, preserving the oath upon mountains and rivers.
units.literal: I shall forever be with you a realm of father and son, preserving the oath upon mountains and rivers.

units.zh: 於戲！
units.en: Alas!
units.literal: Alas!

units.zh: 補百王之闕禮，行茲盛典；
units.en: Repair the deficient rites of the hundred kings and perform this great ceremony;
units.literal: Repair the deficient rites of the hundred kings and perform this great ceremony;

units.zh: 成千載之大義，遂我初心。
units.en: complete the great righteousness of a thousand ages and fulfill my original intent.
units.literal: complete the great righteousness of a thousand ages and fulfill my original intent.

units.zh: 爾其永保兆民，勉持一德，慎乃有位，允執厥中。
units.en: Forever preserve the myriad people, strive to hold to one virtue, be careful in your position, and truly hold fast to the center.
units.literal: You shall forever preserve the myriad people, strive to hold to one virtue, be careful in your position, and truly hold fast to the center.

units.zh: 亦惟無疆之休，其誡之哉！
units.en: May there also be boundless blessing. Take this as your warning!
units.literal: May there also be boundless blessing—take this as your warning!

units.zh: 禮畢，帝鼓吹道從而歸。
units.en: When the ceremony was complete, the Emperor returned with drums and pipes clearing the road before him.
units.literal: When the ceremony was complete, the Emperor returned with drums and pipes clearing the road before him.

units.zh: 謂福曰：「吾已兆於夢，皆上帝命我，非我意也。」
units.en: He said to Fu: "I have already been foretold in a dream. All of this is the Supreme Lord's command to me, not my own intent."
units.literal: He said to Fu: "I have already been foretold in a dream; all is the Supreme Lord's command to me, not my own intent."

units.zh: 母曰：「可命筮。」
units.en: His mother said: "You may order divination."
units.literal: His mother said: "You may order divination."

units.zh: 不以繒帛，不以珠金，若響應聲。
units.en: Without silks, without pearls and gold, he came like an echo answering a sound.
units.literal: Without silks, without pearls and gold, he came like an echo answering a sound.

units.zh: 及蕃軍大至，合勢破之，末帝之眾，似拉朽焉。
units.en: When the Khitan army arrived in great force and joined strength to break them, the Last Emperor's host collapsed like rotten wood pulled apart.
units.literal: When the barbarian army arrived in great force and joined strength to break them, the Last Emperor's host was like pulling rotten wood apart.

units.zh: 後復夢，即前神人也，衣冠儀貌，儼然如故，曰：「石郎已使人來喚汝。」
units.en: Later he dreamed again. It was the same divine man as before, robes, cap, bearing, and appearance all exactly as before, who said: "Master Shi has already sent men to summon you."
units.literal: Later he dreamed again—it was the same divine man as before, robes, cap, bearing, and appearance all exactly as before, who said: "Master Shi has already sent men to summon you."
